verdict.reason: The check passes. I re-confirmed the Omega price ($7,800, ref 310.30.42.50.01.001) on The 1916 Company's page, and the earlier review confirmed the Breitling's $8,400 at Betteridge. Both names now fit on two lines, so the prices on slide 2 line up. The footnote is merged into the cover line, and the two prices are about 8% apart. The Moonwatch also appeared in the Nov 20 Explorer post, but this is a different matchup.
